ask: C++17, header-only. lru.hpp and test.cpp: LRU cache template LRU<K,V> with capacity, get/put/erase/size, std::list + std::unordered_map, move semantics. test.cpp exercises eviction order, updates, and a 10000-entry stress loop with a small assert harness. write the files.
prose:
Both files are written. Here's what's in them.

`lru.hpp` — header-only `LRU<K,V>` template:
- `std::list<std::pair<K,V>>` with MRU at front, LRU at back; `std::unordered_map` stores list iterators for O(1) lookup
- `get` returns `V*` (nullptr on miss) and splices the node to front
- `put` handles insert and update-in-place; evicts the back node at capacity
- `erase`, `size`, `capacity`, `contains`, `peek` (const, no recency touch), `clear`
- Move-only by design (copy deleted, move defaulted); `put` takes key and value by value so rvalues move in cleanly

`test.cpp` — standalone harness with a small `CHECK` macro:
- Basic get/put, eviction order (get refreshes recency before an insert forces eviction)
- Update on existing key refreshes recency and overwrites the value
- Erase (present and missing keys), capacity-1 edge case
- Move semantics with `std::string`, `contains`/`peek` not updating recency, `clear` and reuse, `std::string` keys, zero-capacity throws
- Two stress loops at 10000: a linear fill-then-verify pass against a capacity-100 cache, and a mixed put/erase/get pass with an LCG against capacity-64 that checks the size invariant every iteration

Build and run:

```
g++ -std=c++17 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -o test test.cpp && ./test
```
